items.title: Deceptive Employment Scheme: AI-assisted hiring deception
items.summary: OpenAI banned accounts potentially used to facilitate a deceptive employment scheme with characteristics of publicly reported North Korea-linked IT-worker activity.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI公开宣布封禁了一批可能被用于实施欺诈性雇用计划的违规账户，这些账户带有公开报道中与朝鲜相关的IT劳工活动的特征。此举展示了大模型厂商在防范AI技术被滥用于恶意求职和网络安全威胁方面的监管治理动作。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI采取安全行动打击利用AI辅助虚假招聘与涉朝IT劳工欺诈活动的违规账号，对规范大模型安全治理具有现实警示意义。

items.title: Operation “Peer Review”: AI-assisted surveillance planning
items.summary: OpenAI banned likely China-origin accounts using AI to draft surveillance-tool pitches, analyze documents, and debug code.

items.title: Task scam: AI-assisted fake review jobs
items.summary: OpenAI banned accounts that appeared to originate in Cambodia and used AI to translate messages for fake-review job scams that asked victims to pay fees.

items.title: Covert influence operation: Ghana election activity
items.summary: OpenAI banned accounts using AI to generate articles, posts, and fake engagement around Ghana’s 2024 presidential election.

items.title: Cyber threat actors: AI-assisted intrusion research
items.summary: OpenAI banned accounts potentially associated with publicly reported DPRK-affiliated threat actors using AI to research intrusion tooling, phishing, malware, and cryptocurrency targeting.

items.title: Iranian influence nexus: Cross-platform activity
items.summary: OpenAI banned Iran-linked accounts using AI to generate articles and social posts tied to IUVM and STORM-2035 influence activity.

items.title: Romance-baiting scam: AI-assisted pig butchering workflows
items.summary: OpenAI banned accounts that appeared to originate in Cambodia and used AI to translate and generate romance, investment scam conversations.

items.title: Operation “Sponsored Discontent”: Influence activity
items.summary: OpenAI banned likely China-origin accounts using AI to generate English social posts and Spanish-language articles.
